fieldValues.title: The process is re-founded instead of evolved
fieldValues.statement: Every few weeks the way work is driven is replaced whole: the epic-worker skills (retired in August), the unit walk (September), the reboot from Project #5 to #6 (2026-10-08), units frozen then revived as holons (2026-10-21). Each re-founding loses what the last one learnt and leaves its labels, docs and copies behind.
source_ref: Flow model B, across the stages (container b9c5106b)
